title: Kill The Admin! SSS Event!
description:
An video of an old event called "Kill the Admin"

Original Description:
Back on Silver Springs (back? we never left!) for an event; Kill the Admin- or in this case, Staff. The players must kill the staff members. The staff members are vastly outnumbered, so their gear is better.

Unfortunately I only got the recording started about halfway through the event. 

It was a very fun event! Congrats to BuddyBoy for killing Britt and to the mini minotaur for killing me!

I also threw in a little montage at the end lol
